operator_observation: Dave opened projects that required his attention but had no practical place to approve, reject, delegate, or clarify what MIM/TOD needed from him. MIM also answered an Account Manager project blocker question as a Reports/App Metrics question.
root_cause: Selected project view had a generic edit/note form but no Dave decision workflow.
MIM Studio chat routed AgentMIM/comm_app words to Reports mode before checking project blocker intent.
fix: Add Dave Needed decision panel to selected projects marked dave_needed.
Add decision choices: approve, approve limited, reject, delegate, waiting external, clarification.
Record Dave decisions as project events and update blocker, work_state, dave_needed, status, and next_action.
Add project-blocker chat path before Reports routing so MIM answers what it needs from Dave for a project.
validation: AgentMIM Account Manager Roles renders a Dave Needed decision box.
MIM replies in project_blocker mode for the Account Manager Roles blocker question.
MIM answer now states the approval needed, reason, choices, impact, and next action.
training_lesson: When Dave asks what MIM needs from him for a project blocker, MIM must answer from the project ledger and operator-action contract before any Reports/App Metrics routing.
